summary: Defines a binding for the JSON Meta Application Protocol (JMAP) over WebSocket. It provides better performance than the HTTP binding for JMAP. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: JMAP is a way for email programs to talk to mail servers. This document lets them keep one open line, like a phone call, so the talking is quicker than sending many separate letters.

questions: how to run jmap over websocket
